slides.title: A 10-minute *weekly check-in* for couples
slides.sub: Five questions, every Sunday. Like a weather report for your relationship.

slides.text: What was the *best moment* of our week?

slides.body: Small clouds are easier to clear early.

slides.text: Is there *anything coming up* that feels stressful?
How can I *support you* this week?
slides.body: One specific thing. Write it down.

slides.text: What’s *one thing* we should do together?
slides.body: A walk, a meal, a movie. Put it on the calendar.

slides.title: Save this *for Sunday night.*
slides.sub: Ten minutes, two mugs, five questions. Every week.
